sloka: कामरूपः कामचारी कामगः प्लवतां वरः ।भवत्यव्याहतगतिः कीर्तिमांश्च भविष्यति ।। ७.३६.२४ ॥
transliteration: kāmarūpaḥ kāmacārī kāmagaḥ plavatāṁ varaḥ ।bhavatyavyāhatagatiḥ kīrtimāṁśca bhaviṣyati ।। 7.36.24 ॥

translations.english: Hanuman will possess the ability to assume any form, move anywhere at will, be the foremost among leapers, have unhindered movement, and achieve great fame.
